detail.title: CP-UVR-0804K4-I3-V3
features: Max. 12 Channels IP camera inputs, Each channel up to 6MP, Max. 64 Mbps incoming bandwidth, 64 Mbps outgoing bandwidth, 64 recording bandwidth
Support 4 SATA HDD up to 16TB Each, 3 USB Ports
Up to 4 Channels video stream (analog channel) perimeter protection
Up to 2 Channels video stream (analog channel) human face recognition

General.IP Camera Input: Up to 12 Channels of IPC access 4 IP Channels by default + 8 Channels (analog channels are  converted to IP channels) Incoming bandwidth: 64 Mbps, Recording bandwidth: 64 Mbps and  outgoing bandwidth: 64 Mbps  *After IP channels are added beyond the existing channels, the AI Function (IVS, SMD, FACE)  will be disabled.
General.Video Streaming: Main stream: 5MP Mode: 4-ch 5MP@(1-6fps); other channels 5M-N@ (1-12fps)  5M-N Mode: All channel 5M-N@(1–12fps);4M-N,1080p@(1–15fps); 1080N, 720p, 960H,  D1,CIF@(1–25/30fps)  Sub stream: D1, CIF@(1–15fps)
General.Video Display Split: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8; When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16
General.Hard Disk: 4 SATA ports, up to 16TB capacity for each disk. The maximum HDD capacity varies with environment temperature
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 10,000 face images in total. Name, Gender, Birthday, Address,  Certificate type, Certificate No., Countries & Regions and state can be added to each face image
General.Interface Ports: 3 (1 front USB 2.0 port, 2 rear USB 2.0 ports), 1 RS485 Port (for PTZ control), 1 RS232 (1 port, for PC Communication & Keyboard)
General.Protocols: HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, RTSP, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, DDNS,  Alarm Server, InstaOn, Auto Registration, ONVIF 22.12(Profile T, Profile S, Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Alarm Output: 6 Channels (5 Channel relay output, 1 Channel 12 V 1 A output)
